args.sql:
WITH ccs AS (
  SELECT s.signalregistry,
         t.observstation,
         rp.resprio,
         (1 - sp.falseposprob) * (sd.decodeconf/100.0) *
           (CASE WHEN (s.snrratio - 0.1*abs(s.noisefloordbm)) > 0
                 THEN (s.snrratio - 0.1*abs(s.noisefloordbm))/10.0 + 0.5
                 ELSE 0.1 END) AS ccs_val
  FROM signals s
  JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
  JOIN signalprobabilities sp ON s.signalregistry = sp.signalref
  JOIN signaldecoding sd ON s.signalregistry = sd.signalref
  LEFT JOIN researchprocess rp ON s.signalregistry = rp.signalref
)
SELECT observstation AS observatory_name,
       COUNT(*) AS total_signals,
       ROUND(AVG(ccs_val), 4) AS avg_ccs,
       ROUND(AVG(ccs_val), 4) AS approx_ccs,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE resprio IN ('High','Urgent')) AS important_signals,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ccs_val > 0.8) AS high_confidence_signals,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE resprio IN ('High','Urgent') AND ccs_val > 0.8) AS both_criteria
FROM ccs
GROUP BY observstation
ORDER BY both_criteria DESC, high_confidence_signals DESC, important_signals DESC;

  SELECT s.signalregistry,
         t.observstation,
         rp.resprio,
         (1 - sp.falseposprob) * (sd.decodeconf/100.0) *
           (CASE WHEN (s.snrratio - 0.1*abs(s.noisefloordbm)) > 0

                 ELSE 0.1 END) AS ccs_val
  FROM signals s
  JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
  JOIN signalprobabilities sp ON s.signalregistry = sp.signalref
  JOIN signaldecoding sd ON s.signalregistry = sd.signalref
  LEFT JOIN researchprocess rp ON s.signalregistry = rp.signalref

WITH ccs AS (
  SELECT s.signalregistry,
         t.observstation,
         rp.resprio,
         (1 - sp.falseposprob) * (sd.decodeconf/100.0) *
           (CASE WHEN (s.snrratio - 0.1*abs(s.noisefloordbm)) > 0
                 THEN (s.snrratio - 0.1*abs(s.noisefloordbm))/10.0 + 0.5
                 ELSE 0.1 END) AS ccs_val
  FROM signals s
  JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
  JOIN signalprobabilities sp ON s.signalregistry = sp.signalref
  JOIN signaldecoding sd ON s.signalregistry = sd.signalref
  LEFT JOIN researchprocess rp ON s.signalregistry = rp.signalref
)
SELECT observstation AS observatory_name,
       COUNT(*) AS total_signals,
       ROUND(AVG(ccs_val), 4) AS avg_ccs,
       ROUND(AVG(ccs_val), 4) AS approx_ccs,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE resprio IN ('High','Urgent')) AS important_signals,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ccs_val > 0.8) AS high_confidence_signals,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE resprio IN ('High','Urgent') AND ccs_val > 0.8) AS both_criteria
FROM ccs
GROUP BY observstation
ORDER BY both_criteria DESC, high_confidence_signals DESC, important_signals DESC;
